| description = Indifferent to all. Socials with his buddy [[Sindlegrob]] as well as the nearby undead, though his tower blocks line of sight well enough to where you wouldn't know. They social with their "pets" as well, but are not directly tied to them, meaning that you can pull them and their pet separately.

The pets belonging to the trio of gnomes for the Clay Bracelet quest have some bewildering properties. First, they are ''not actually pets'', but mobs themselves. Their corpses can be looted (though I've yet to see anything drop), memblurring them will send them back to the location where they were summoned, and charming their owners does not cause them to despawn.
